repos.name: Ephemeris
repos.description: Ephemeris is a Swift framework for satellite tracking and orbital mechanics calculations. It provides tools to parse Two-Line Element (TLE) data and calculate orbital positions for Earth-orbiting satellites. The framework is dual-purpose: both a practical Swift library for iOS/macOS developers and an educational tool for learning orbital mechanics.

repos.description: Mercator is a modular, extensible toolkit for analyzing source code repositories using Abstract Syntax Trees (ASTs) powered by Tree-Sitter. It is designed to generate actionable code quality metrics and code structure understanding.

repos.name: coopcam
repos.description: I wanna identify birds at the bird feeder, remotely. CoopCam Bird Camera — a two-device embedded system that photographs birds, classifies them using on-device ML, and displays results on a touchscreen. The camera unit and display unit communicate wirelessly via ESP-NOW (peer-to-peer, no router).
